dedupe_keys.name: comprensori di bonifica e di irrigazione sibiter

description: Comprensori di bonifica e di irrigazione (SIBITER) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportale.regione.lombardia.it. The map shows the subdivision of the “non-mountain” regional territory into Comprehensori di Bonifica e Irrigazione, homogeneous hydrographic and hydraulic units, functional to the needs of programming, execution and management of the activity of reclamation of irrigation and soil protection (Article 78 Regional Law 31/2008). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Remediation and irrigation areas (SIBITER)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include consorzi, inspire priority data set, bonifica, irrigazione, foreste e uso del suolo, agricoltura. The listing shows 2018-02-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
